exhaustiveFieldMutationFamilies.mechanism: remove each required property from each actually applicable object/union arm, for every real array instance, retaining all earlier prerequisites
exhaustiveFieldMutationFamilies.decision: reject at actor owning schema shape; header malformed retains raw; child exit only actual; no skipped branch false alarm

exhaustiveFieldMutationFamilies.mechanism: add one unlisted property to each actual strict object, including each nested array member/selected union arm
exhaustiveFieldMutationFamilies.decision: reject, never silently strip unknown fields

exhaustiveFieldMutationFamilies.mechanism: replace each present value by a JSON type outside all permitted arms, or unequal const/enum; include bool for every integer and null where forbidden
exhaustiveFieldMutationFamilies.decision: reject; preserve actual failure raw; no coerce/omit/default

exhaustiveFieldMutationFamilies.mechanism: verify fixed schema definition bytes/pointer identity only
exhaustiveFieldMutationFamilies.decision: no fabricated runtime field or runtime mutation for unreferenced definitions
